summary: Completed focused browser verification of Tejas JEE/BITSAT practice platform. Verified UI rendering, navigation, authentication flows (owner and student login), API integration, design consistency (matte-maroon theme), and Studio content management interface. All core UI elements render correctly, authentication works properly, and API endpoints return expected responses. No MOCKED integrations found - all features use real backend APIs.

backend_issues.notes: Backend APIs tested via browser fetch calls - all returning proper responses. /api/sets returns empty array (no published sets yet, expected). /api/auth/me returns owner role correctly. /api/studio/sets returns draft set data.

frontend_issues.notes: All UI elements render correctly. Studio editor shows expected image loading errors for unprocessed source PDFs (not a bug - content needs to be uploaded/processed first). Design uses proper matte-maroon color scheme (rgb(92, 0, 37)) as specified.
